title: MoCa: Measuring Human-Language Model Alignment on Causal and Moral Judgment Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model responses on causal judgment vignettes and calculating the Average Marginal Component Effect (AMCE) to measure sensitivity to human cognitive heuristics, such as the omission bias, event normality, and temporal effects.

Evaluating language model responses on moral dilemma vignettes and calculating the Average Marginal Component Effect (AMCE) to measure implicit moral tendencies regarding factors like self-beneficence, use of personal force, and inevitable vs. avoidable harm.

Using the Social Simulacra framework to prompt models with various political and ideological personas (e.g., liberal activists, conservatives) to observe variances and elicited alignments in their causal and moral judgments.
